data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 83.1m (2013: GBP 59.1m) is an improvement of GBP 6.4m to claims reserves established at the prior year end. This favourable loss development is spread across multiple classes of business and years of account and is caused by both attritional losses not developing as originally anticipated and improvements on previously held catastrophe loss reserves. The most significant favourable development occurred on the 2012 year of account and related to the Property (Direct & Facultative) class.
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reports a net favourable prior-year reserve development of GBP 6.4m (a release), driven by benign catastrophe experience, lower-than-expected attritional and large loss activity and improvements to previously held catastrophe loss reserves. The improvement is spread across multiple classes and years of account, with the most significant favourable development noted on the 2012 year of account affecting Property (Direct & Facultative) and reserve improvements also noted in Marine (Hull & Liability) lines.

data.data_quality_notes: No gross prior-year movement (gross insurance-liabilities) figure was identified in the notes; the report explicitly states a GBP 6.4m improvement but as a NET figure within 'net claims incurred'. Per instructions the NET figure is used as a fallback. The movement labeled 'Movement in provision' in the technical provisions table (gross movement GBP 32.239m) includes current-year development and was therefore not used. No gross claims development triangle was found in the disclosed pages. 'Starr Tech Onshore' is referenced as having improvement but is not mapped to a single standard Lloyd's LOB in the report; amounts by LOB for the prior-year movement are not quantified.
